notes.title: Looking back at Montreal Comic Con 🇨🇦
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]It’s already been a month since Montreal Comic Con, and on this August 4th, we’re taking a moment to look back at this amazing weekend.[/p][p]We had the chance to be selected by Loto Québec (thanks again) to showcase [i]Pluralys[/i] in the Indie Game Zone — an incredible opportunity for a young indie studio like ours to present our cozy RPG to new players! [/p][p]Preparing for the event was quite a challenge for the team: ensuring that the demo was stable, creating a stand that reflected the Pluralys universe, printing business cards, creating a banner and T-shirts for the team, but every effort was worth it.[/p][p]Here are a few photos from our booth and some authentic moments we shared with the Comic Con crowd.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/28cd06f946f914c00011741a32ec5552208afc86.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/db1ca10da5053affe6a60028edf4ac36edb5d889.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/bf08651f277b7017014e7665a7e70d279a48d5a2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/d89de4ca11be7e4d036e7c53293f73766e68e0da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/249af65e6fb39b8a1a517ea9130c300eb8bf7267.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/43b2941fd2354749aa9a09b2e47b27286b0e8c32.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/76bc88be36db2aa2f06b6704178004dd5e248655.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/345fa6eaf83423447e93d671b0c046fd93d90bbd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/2f06d047e16c4f16c2a67a328db2f1f4cfb502eb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/7c105c19e96d62577c1f6225acc024d9870bd0c4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/afcee4042b94efad45f187f38b45cbff94814b42.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/4f0eac98a57a2c85c2999c258eec430dc4e594f8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/dc26a71b41fc451dee1df1b6dd2c76a10fe1852a.png"][/img][/carousel][p]It was also a great chance for our team to meet players in person, exchange ideas, and receive valuable feedback on the game. It's a rare opportunity for most developers, and we're truly grateful for it.[/p][h3]
🎥 You can also relive the event in video, including:[/h3][p]
An [b]exclusive interview with one of our programmers[/b] by Loto Québec :[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/A0wBdota55U"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]A [b]recap video[/b] of the whole weekend:  [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Wj8r4XbJ6qo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by to meet us[/p][p][/p][p]Others news will come very soon ;) [/p][p][/p][p]See you soon! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Supporting Leucan, Expanding to Spanish & Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Proud to support Leucan![/b][/h1]

We’re happy to share that Studios Ivalys is now officially a Leucan Defender (association for children with cancer) — a cause that’s close to our hearts. Every small gesture matters, and we’re honored to contribute in our own way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/c61d97d56eefab099082121fc457fead8eade620.jpg[/img]

[h1][b] Spanish version in the works![/b][/h1]

We're currently working on a Spanish version of Pluralys, so even more players can experience its strange and heartfelt world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/135ce2ad045e1ce8848a5a3e375e09f8a0568556.png[/img]

[h1][b]Steam Next Fest is almost here![/b][/h1]

We wanted to let you know that the demo is now live on Steam and will be available until June 16 as part of the Steam Next Fest (June 9–16).

It’s the perfect time to dive into the strange and funny world of Pluralys — our cozy 2D narrative RPG all about exploration, humor, and unexpected encounters.

Wishlisting the game already helps us a lot, but if you’d like to support us even further, feel free to leave a review on the demo — it would mean the world to us!

Thanks you so much!

notes.title: Demo Available for Steam Next Fest + Ukrainian Version in the Works!
notes.notes:
[h2]We're taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest![/h2]

We’ve got some exciting news to share: we’re participating in the Steam Next Fest!
A fully playable demo will be available for free — no sign-up or selection required — throughout the entire event.

You’ll be able to access it directly from our game’s main Steam page.
Don’t miss this opportunity to dive into the world of Pluralys!

As a reminder, the [b]next Steam Next Fest will take place from June 9 to June 16.[/b]

To make sure you don’t miss anything, add the game to your wishlist and get notified as soon as the demo goes live.


[h3]In the meantime, check out our teaser !
[/h3]

[previewyoutube=nCtmHozC-oI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]We also have another great announcement to share!
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/5f16700ec6ecdd69fe076bf41e9f85306cfab50d.png[/img]

We’re happy to announce that the Ukrainian translation is currently in progress!
We want to make the game accessible to as many players as possible, and this new language will be added soon.

Feel free to reach out if you’d like to see Pluralys translated into other languages in the future!

If you'd like to chat with us or follow the project more closely, come join our Discord community!
